title: mimulus glabratus var. fremontii
intro: Mimulus glabratus var. fremontii, commonly known as Fremont's yellow monkey flower, is a perennial plant species in the family Phrymaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and alleviating symptoms of depression. The therapeutic actions of Mimulus glabratus var. fremontii are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine and anxiolytic, providing emotional support and calming effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
